'''Madoon''' was a soldier of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed in the [[High Security Section]] of [[Belsavis prison]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] prisoners of the [[Blood of Talath]] tribe broke free during the riot and began ambushing prison guards, imitating bird voices for communication. Madoon was one of the guards that fell prey to such attack and failed to respond to a comm check from officer [[Serik]].<ref name="STL" />
